In every plan

The floor is already high.

Even a day pass opens the whole club. There is no bronze tier that locks you out of the pool, and no surcharge waiting at the spa door. What changes between plans is how often you come and how far ahead you can book — not what you are allowed to touch.

  • Every court, green, lane and studio
  • Recovery suite, sauna and pool
  • Towels, showers and kit storage
  • No surcharge on any facility
What drives the price

Where your money goes.

Capped membership

We hold numbers below what the club could take, so courts stay open.

Coaches on salary

Our pros are employed, not commission-chasing — clinics cost you nothing.

Daily groundskeeping

Clay watered and rolled every morning; greens cut six days a week.

Kit that gets replaced

Nets, balls, machines and gym plate all on a fixed renewal cycle.

No joining fee

We would rather you stayed because it is good than because you paid to enter.

One price, all in

No peak pricing, no booking fees, no guest surcharge inside your allowance.

The fine print

No surprises.

Is there a joining fee?

No. You pay a simple monthly price and nothing to start.

Can I cancel?

Anytime, with 30 days’ notice. No contracts, no penalties.

Can I freeze my membership?

Yes — pause for up to three months a year for travel or injury.

Do prices rise each year?

We review once a year and cap any change at inflation. You get 60 days’ notice, always.

Can I switch tiers?

Up or down, at any point in the month. We pro-rate the difference on your next bill.

What about guests?

Residents bring four a month, Signature members bring unlimited. Guests use everything you can.

Worth it?

Members on the price.
